implementation: Advertise hoverProvider and handle textDocument/hover for open .k documents
Check a fresh source graph against all current buffers and configured packages; no partial typed IR
Resolve declaration/read spans, direct and pipeline call targets, imported aliases and record fields using checked identities
Display inferred numeric/collection/closure types, tensor shapes and named error channels with private inference/capture details omitted
Negotiate plaintext or fenced Markdown and return original-token UTF-16 ranges
Share cursor mapping with incremental edits and bound hover presentation work/output

coverage: Exact inferred types at binding/parameter declarations and reads, same-spelled parameters in separate functions
Direct calls, function references, closure signatures and pipeline targets
Record field declarations/reads and nominal type declarations
Dynamic/fixed tensor shape display without inference IDs
Application-error signatures/unions and separate factory/callback error channels
String literal content is omitted; UTF-16 Unicode/CRLF token ranges
Plaintext/Markdown protocol responses and exact original-source ranges
Incremental binding type changes and unsaved imported alias target signatures
Failed graphs never return stale/partial types; closed/unmapped/invalid positions return null or invalid-params
A valid 3000-parameter function exceeds the presentation limit and returns no hover
Existing lifecycle/framing, edit transaction, overlays and frontend regressions

limitations: No hover for annotation tokens, import/re-export declaration tokens, builtin call signatures or general operator selections

Fresh synchronous checking per request; no cached workspace or latency guarantee
No native completion/navigation/formatting or real-editor/cross-platform qualification in this milestone
